snapshot.note: Read directly from KAI’s public Shopify storefront endpoints. Images are references to KAI’s CDN and are not stored in this repository. Prices are EGP as listed on the checked date.

verification.method: direct — KAI’s public Shopify storefront endpoints (products.json, collections/<handle>/products.json)
verification.name: verified (products.json title; apostrophes/case normalised)
verification.url: verified (handle from products.json and SS26 collection membership)
verification.price: verified on the snapshot date — not live
verification.sizes: verified per variant, with availability on the snapshot date; labels whitespace-normalised
verification.composition: verified from the product description where KAI states one (compositionStated)
verification.photography: KAI’s own, referenced from KAI’s CDN; every lead image checked to resolve
verification.usageRestrictions: Factual product data cited for an unofficial concept. Photographs are KAI’s; referenced by URL, not stored in this repository.

historical.note: The earlier search-index snapshot (56 products, 2026-10-14) checked against the live store. Only current SS26 products are presented as current.
